Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the first step by misinterpreting the question. The question asks "Which film has the director who is older," which requires comparing the **absolute age** (or birth date) of the directors at the time of the films or currently. The Planner incorrectly concluded that "older birth year means older director" but then proceeded to calculate the **age of the directors at the time of the film release** (e.g., Don McGuire was 37 in 1956, Nunzio Malasomma was 31 in 1925) and incorrectly stated "Don McGuire was 37 at the time of Johnny Concho... while Nunzio Malasomma was 31... Therefore, Johnny Concho's director is older." This logic is flawed because the comparison should be based on the birth dates (1894 vs 1919). Nunzio Malasomma (born 1894) is objectively older than Don McGuire (born 1919), regardless of the year the film was made. The Planner's confusion between "age at time of film" and "who is the older person" led to the wrong conclusion.
